reason: 5.8.0 closes audit F1, the last critical finding: allow grants silently nullified every require_approval policy in an org. Grants now carry a TTL (30d default, stamped at creation; legacy grants age out from created_at), require an explicit target scope (unscoped blanket grants rejected at both the validator and the review-feed verdict), never satisfy a policy across an evidence reclassification, and can never clear a rule marked ungrantable. /policies renders every currently-inert rule with the grant suppressing it. Minor bump: the grant contract is narrower than before. Platform-only; no SDK surface change.
